inspections.title: Food stored or prepared unsafely
inspections.detail: Procure food from sources approved or considered satisfactory and store, prepare, distribute and serve food in accordance with professional standards.

inspections.title: Infection control not followed
inspections.detail: Provide and implement an infection prevention and control program.

inspections.title: Put firmly secured handrails on each side of hallways
inspections.detail: Put firmly secured handrails on each side of hallways.

inspections.title: Medications not labeled or stored correctly
inspections.detail: Ensure drugs and biologicals used in the facility are labeled in accordance with currently accepted professional principles; and all drugs and biologicals must be stored in locked compartments, separately locked, compartments for controlled drugs.

inspections.title: Provide sufficient support personnel to safely and effectively carry out the functions of the food and nutrition service
inspections.detail: Provide sufficient support personnel to safely and effectively carry out the functions of the food and nutrition service.

inspections.title: Unclean or uncomfortable living space
inspections.detail: Honor the resident's right to a safe, clean, comfortable and homelike environment, including but not limited to receiving treatment and supports for daily living safely.

inspections.title: Transfer / bed-hold notice not given
inspections.detail: Provide the required documentation or notification related to the resident's needs, appeal rights, or bed-hold policies.

inspections.title: Care plan not updated on time
inspections.detail: Develop the complete care plan within 7 days of the comprehensive assessment; and prepared, reviewed, and revised by a team of health professionals.

inspections.title: Care not given as ordered
inspections.detail: Provide appropriate treatment and care according to orders, resident’s preferences and goals.

inspections.title: Pressure sores not prevented or treated
inspections.detail: Provide appropriate pressure ulcer care and prevent new ulcers from developing.

inspections.title: Incontinence or catheter care problems
inspections.detail: Provide appropriate care for residents who are continent or incontinent of bowel/bladder, appropriate catheter care,  and appropriate care  to prevent urinary tract infections.

inspections.title: Not enough food or fluids
inspections.detail: Provide enough food/fluids to maintain a resident's health.

inspections.title: Medication error rate of 5% or more
inspections.detail: Ensure medication error rates are not 5 percent or greater.

inspections.title: Significant medication error
inspections.detail: Ensure that residents are free from significant medication errors.

inspections.title: Food stored or prepared unsafely
inspections.detail: Procure food from sources approved or considered satisfactory and store, prepare, distribute and serve food in accordance with professional standards.

inspections.title: No full-time social worker
inspections.detail: Hire a qualified full-time social worker in a facility with more than 120 beds.

inspections.title: Resident choices not respected
inspections.detail: Honor the resident's right to and the facility must promote and facilitate resident self-determination through support of resident choice.

inspections.title: Infection control not followed
inspections.detail: Provide and implement an infection prevention and control program.

inspections.title: CPR / life support not provided properly
inspections.detail: Provide basic life support, including CPR, prior to the arrival of emergency medical personnel , subject to physician orders and the resident’s advance directives.

inspections.title: Allow residents to self-administer drugs if determined clinically appropriate
inspections.detail: Allow residents to self-administer drugs if determined clinically appropriate.
